entry.title: Pass through the main module when everything is passed through (#2141)
entry.content:
Pass through the main module when everything is passed through (#2141)

A workflow defined in __main__ is imported in the sandbox as
__temporal_main__, which the host does not have. Passing it through
failed validation with ModuleNotFoundError, so pass through the host's
__main__ instead.

Signed-off-by: 1fanwang <1fannnw@gmail.com>

entry.title: Pass through from-imported submodules in the workflow sandbox (#2136)
entry.content:
Pass through from-imported submodules in the workflow sandbox (#2136)

importlib imports a package's fromlist submodules with its own import
function, so the sandbox importer never saw them and reloaded a submodule
that imports_passed_through() should have passed through. Offer them to the
importer too.

entry.content:
Skip no-op payload passes and context lookups without a codec or external storage (#2090)

* Skip no-op payload passes without a codec or external storage

* Keep the context-free failure converter and skip the store pass without external storage

- With a cached workflow and no codec or external storage, activation
  failures are converted with the context-free converter, as before.
- encode_completion runs the external storage pass only when external
  storage is configured, so a codec-only worker makes no store-context
  lookups.
- The test also counts get_external_store_context lookups and covers a
  converter with external storage.

entry.title: fix(lambda-worker): create OTel tracer provider once per process (#2041)
entry.content:
fix(lambda-worker): create OTel tracer provider once per process (#2041)

apply_defaults is called from the configure callback, which run_worker
invokes on every Lambda invocation. Each call built a new
TracerProvider with an OTLP BatchSpanProcessor, but OpenTelemetry only
allows the global provider to be set once, so from the second warm
invocation on the new provider was never installed or shut down,
leaking an export thread and gRPC channel per invocation.

Install the provider once and reuse it on later calls. If another
provider already owns the global slot, shut the unused one down.
